title: Cheese, Mushroom and Onion Tart
subtitle: with a mixed cheese filling on pizza dough
description: A quick free-form tart of chilled pizza dough filled with sauteed mushrooms and onion and a creamy mix of goat cheese, labneh, ricotta and melting cheese.

steps.text: Warm the goat cheese log briefly in the microwave and stir well (the heat softens it and makes it easier to work with). Use short pulses so it does not burn.
Add the cream, labneh, ricotta, mozzarella, 1 egg, salt and pepper to the goat cheese and mix well.
Heat olive oil in a wide pan and fry the thinly sliced onion and mushrooms until the onion turns translucent.
Add a few basil leaves, mix well and set aside.
Lightly oil a baking tin and lay the chilled dough over it, leaving the edges of the dough hanging over the sides. Spread the mushroom mixture over the dough and pour the cheese mixture on top.
Fold the excess dough inwards over the filling (the dough should not completely cover the cheese) and brush the dough with the remaining egg, beaten.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until golden. If the top starts to burn, lower the temperature slightly and bake for another 5 minutes.
